endpoints.summary: Run `genie3 generate` with a fully custom YAML config.
endpoints.description:
Run `genie3 generate` with a fully custom YAML config.

`paths.rootdir` and (if a dataset zip is provided) `paths.dataset` are
rewritten so the YAML you supply doesn't need to know its job_dir.

request_fields.name: config_yaml
request_fields.description: Full experiment YAML as a string.

request_fields.name: dataset
request_fields.description: Optional dataset zip; extracted to <job>/input/dataset/.

request_fields.name: num_devices
request_fields.description: Override GPU auto-detect.

examples.title: custom YAML with cond_strategy override (the common gotcha)
examples.curl:
curl -X POST $URL/api/generate -F 'config_yaml=experiment:
  name: trem1_vhh
generation:
  dataset:
    source: target
    selections: trem1_vhh
    n_sample: 4
    cond_strategy: hotspot' -F dataset=@trem1.zip
examples.notes: Default cond_strategy='extended' fails with ValueError: Interface mode 'extended' not found when the problem JSON only defines 'hotspot'. Override here to use the hotspot interface.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

tool_outputs.note: Each `genie3 generate` run nests its PDBs under the experiment name from the YAML (`experiment.name`). Use `/api/jobs/{id}/files` to list, or `/api/jobs/{id}/file/{relpath}` to fetch one.

input_uri_schemes.upload: multipart/form-data zip with problems/ + targets/ (binder) or problems/ + motifs/ (motif). The server rewrites filepath fields in problem JSONs to absolute paths after extraction.

endpoints_summary./api/generate/unconditional: No dataset; configurable min/max length + step.
endpoints_summary./api/generate/motif: Dataset zip with motifs/; scaffold around motif residues.
endpoints_summary./api/generate/binder: Dataset zip with targets/; design binder against target.
endpoints_summary./api/generate: Freeform YAML body via `config_yaml` Form field. The server auto-fills `paths.rootdir` and (if a dataset zip is attached) `paths.dataset`. Use this for `cond_strategy` overrides or iterative refinement configs.

config_tips.cond_strategy: Default upstream `cond_strategy: extended` requires an `extended` interface in the problem JSON. If your problem only defines `hotspot`, override via `generation.dataset.cond_strategy: hotspot`.
config_tips.direction_scale: Quality/diversity knob. Recommended 0.8 for length ≤ 300, 0.0 for longer (unconditional) or for binder mode (default 0.0).
